summary.en: Russia sent a major business delegation to Kabul for talks with the Taliban, while Iran and Afghanistan expanded agricultural trade to $2.7 billion. In Rajasthan, a Punjab woman was recruited by a Pakistan-based ISI handler through a romantic relationship and participated in a railway-track blast that killed two people, prompting arrests of two suspects linked to Pakistani handlers. Separate incidents include a blast from unexploded ordnance in Ghazni that killed one child and injured another, and two shootings in South Africa that left 17 dead. The conflict recorded 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
